entries.text: aries, mars is literally begging you to stop texting first. protect your fire.
taurus, venus said the person meant for you moves slow too. stop rushing the garden.
gemini, mercury sees both versions of you and loves them equally. someone else will too.
cancer, the moon keeps receipts of everyone who made you cry. rest easy.
leo, the sun does not ask the clouds for permission. neither should you.
virgo, the universe is not grading you. put the red pen down.
libra, balance doesn't mean carrying both sides alone. venus said put it down.
scorpio, pluto destroyed itself so you would know transformation is survivable.
sagittarius, jupiter expands whatever you feed it. stop feeding the doubt.
capricorn, saturn says the mountain isn't going anywhere. you're allowed to sleep.
aquarius, uranus made you different on purpose. the frequency finds its people.
pisces, neptune gave you the dreams because you're the only one who would believe them.
